reason: The engine grid's timed steps run none of #980's changed lines, so #980 cannot add the +0.27% (about 55 us per 21.1 ms step) as per-step work. The grid times _dummy_run: a target forward on zeroed dummy tokens plus DSparkSpeculator.propose(dummy_run=True). That path never samples (sampler.py, states.py), never calls record_confidences (adaptive_verification.py), and DSpark with its TileLang confidence head never calls OnlineAcceptanceEstimator.predict; DFlash's predict_from_stats only serves probabilistic vocab-parallel drafts, and the recipe drafts greedily. On the real greedy decode step, a line trace of the five post-step components finds exactly three changed lines executed, all in record_confidences (adaptive_verification.py 269, 270, 274: the tp_invariant getattr hoisted ahead of the TP check, plus a callable() test). In-process A/B/C timing puts the cost at 0.0 to 0.2 us per step, the same as the A/A between byte-identical code. The PR's -17 us broadcast saving does not apply to production either: DSparkSpeculator has exposed tp_invariant_confidence since 0568 and overrides the property #980 adds to DraftModelSpeculator, so the production broadcast was already elided in 1107. The correction (r1) drops that adaptive_verification.py hunk. Its callable() branch is dead: the model runner passes the speculator's value to the manager as a bool when it creates it (model_runner.initialize_kv_cache). With the hunk gone, record_confidences is byte-identical to 1107's, and the trace finds zero changed lines on the greedy path. The same round fixes #980's --seed regression: SamplingStates._seed_rng was np.random.default_rng(0) whatever --seed was, while 1107's unseeded request seeds came from the global NumPy RNG the worker seeds with set_random_seed(ModelConfig.seed). Now the model runner hands ModelConfig.seed to Sampler(seed=...) and SamplingStates(seed=...), which draws unseeded requests' seeds from np.random.default_rng(seed). ModelConfig.seed is the same on every TP rank, so lockstep holds; with no configured seed it falls back to vLLM's default 0, the value 1107 seeded with by default (and #980's default_rng(0)). A new test checks that two seeds give different unseeded seeds, that ranks with one seed agree however each perturbs the global RNG, that no seed equals seed 0, and that the Sampler forwards its seed. Lockstep is kept: the harness-fixed screen with configured seed 1234 shows 0/1000 in every candidate mode and history at TP3 and TP4, both boots, and before the seed change the PR's own screen showed the same with the control reproducing the PR's 263/1000 and 239/1000. The tests pass: 190 passed, 1 skipped, both boots. The TP2 crash is a bug in the screen harness, not in #980 (tp2_finding). Caveat for the 4-node confirmation: r1 keeps #980's sampling changes, which alter the tokens the startup sampler warmup leaves in req_states.last_sampled_tokens. Every grid dummy step feeds those tokens to the MoE draft model. So r1 may show the same grid offset as candidate-48 without adding any per-step work (grid_attribution).

tp2_finding.conclusion: a screen-harness bug, not #980's and not the shared-GPU layout. The serving worker cannot hit it, at TP2, TP3 or TP4
tp2_finding.mechanism: rejection_sample takes draft_sampled as [num_logits] and reads request r's draft i at row cu_num_logits[r] + i + 1 (rejection_sampler_utils.py: tl.load(draft_sampled_ptr + logit_idx + 1)); the worker passes input_ids[logits_indices] (InputBatch.logits_rows), which is [num_logits]. The screen passes draft_tokens.view(-1): num_reqs x num_steps = 40 entries where 48 are read, so the last request reads 8 int64 past the tensor, into its 512-byte allocator block's stale bytes (and every request's drafts are misaligned). The kernel clamps only negative ids (tl.maximum(0, ...)); a stale value at or above the vocab size indexes target and draft logits out of bounds. Whether it faults depends on what the allocator block held, which varies with world size, vocab size (4096 x world) and mode history: hence TP2's candidate_sampled_unseeded, and not TP3/TP4
